specification.objective: Prevent silent loss of unsaved stored-memory drafts across polling and navigation.

requirements.statement: Keep stable entry/target-bound dirty drafts through 5s query polling and prevent overwrite on stale source.
Prompt for continue/discard/save before selection, target, cancellation or plugin-section navigation.
Saving conflicts preserve content; safe reset after success and explicit discard.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Keep stable entry/target-bound dirty drafts through 5s query polling and prevent overwrite on stale source. Target-specific RED test must fail on unmodified baseline and pass after implementation.
Prompt for continue/discard/save before selection, target, cancellation or plugin-section navigation. Target-specific RED test must fail on unmodified baseline and pass after implementation.
Saving conflicts preserve content; safe reset after success and explicit discard. Target-specific RED test must fail on unmodified baseline and pass after implementation.

invariants.statement: Do not change Hermes files, private method bindings, pending approval execution or compaction native application semantics; retain Magi 1.7.8.

forbidden_states.statement: Unapproved, stale or invalid edits are silently applied; LLM is invoked without explicit user opt-in outside compaction.

inputs.statement: Existing Hermes memory entries and Magi Desktop/backend plugin contracts.

outputs.statement: Documented, tested and reversible UX behavior; no direct native memory file writes.

failure_semantics.statement: On invalid source/remote failure preserve memory, preview and user draft; show actionable error.
